name: SP Half Marathon 2026
short_description: A 21.1km half-marathon held on September 26, 2026, at Dataran Sungai Petani, Kedah, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The SP Half Marathon 2026 is a half-marathon race scheduled for September 26, 2026, in Sungai Petani, Kedah, Malaysia. The race covers a distance of 21.1 kilometers and is organized by Generasi Athletic Club at Dataran Sungai Petani. Registration for this event is currently open, allowing runners to sign up for the single half-marathon distance offered.
pros: Registration is currently open, giving runners time to plan and sign up
Held at a defined venue, Dataran Sungai Petani, Kedah, making logistics clear
Organized by an established running body, Generasi Athletic Club
cons: Only a single half-marathon distance (21.1km) is offered, with no other race options listed
research_highlights: The race starts very early to beat the tropical heat: flag-off times are 21km at 3:00am, 10km at 4:00am, and 5km at 7:10am.
Cut-off times are 21km (3.5 hours), 10km (2 hours), and 5km (1.5 hours).
The event is a long-running annual fixture in Sungai Petani — organizers describe it as their '14th anniversary' event, held since at least 2012.
Start/finish is at Dataran Jam Besar / Dataran Sungai Petani on Jalan Ibrahim in the town centre.
Race pack (bib and t-shirt) must be collected in person before race day — no distribution is done on event day itself.
